rule: A cell may reach PROVEN_T2 only if it matches a pod declared here. Pods must be registered BEFORE their forward data is seen; adding one after looking at results is not pre-registration. Everything not listed is scored in the discovery namespace, which cannot promote.
how_to_register: Add a pod with a stable id, the strategy names it covers, and the asset classes / directions it may trade.
Give it hypothesis_id pointing at reports/hypothesis_registry.json and a registered_at date.
Declare the acceptance criteria before the forward window opens.
